title: Infrastructure Takeover Audit
challenge: Client acquired a company with undocumented IT infrastructure spanning 200+ servers, complex Active Directory, and an Azure tenant requiring immediate assessment.
solution: Built automated PowerShell and Azure CLI inventory workflows to document topology, security posture, and compliance gaps end-to-end.
outcome: Delivered full audit in 2 weeks (vs. ~2 months manually), identified $50K in unused resources, and established ongoing monitoring dashboards.

title: CI/CD Pipeline with Jenkins & Ansible
challenge: Manual provisioning required 3+ days per deployment and produced inconsistent environment configurations.
solution: Architected Jenkins orchestration with Ansible configuration management and WinRM/GPO bootstrapping for Azure-hosted Windows servers.
outcome: Cut deployment time from 3 days to 2 hours (93% faster), with consistent builds and self-service provisioning for engineering teams.

title: AI-Powered Morning Briefing
challenge: Daily triage across email, tickets, and project tools consumed 45+ minutes each morning.
solution: Implemented n8n automation + GPT analysis to aggregate, prioritize, and summarize critical tasks into a daily operations brief.
outcome: Reduced prep from 45 minutes to 5 minutes (89% savings), improved prioritization quality, and scaled a reusable template across the team.

title: Identity Security Hardening Program
challenge: Hybrid identity environment had privilege sprawl, inconsistent MFA enforcement, and audit findings tied to access governance gaps.
solution: Implemented Entra ID conditional access baselines, privileged role controls, access review automations, and standardized onboarding/offboarding policy enforcement.
outcome: Improved identity compliance by 40%, reduced high-risk access exposure, and established a repeatable control framework for quarterly audits.

title: Azure Cost Optimization & Rightsizing
challenge: Rapid cloud growth created unclear spend ownership, oversized compute footprints, and no operational cost guardrails.
solution: Delivered resource tagging governance, rightsizing recommendations, reserved-capacity strategy, and automated weekly cost anomaly reporting.
outcome: Reduced monthly cloud spend by ~22% within one quarter while improving visibility and accountability across engineering teams.

title: Incident-to-Runbook Automation
challenge: Recurring incidents were resolved manually with inconsistent response quality and weak knowledge transfer between teams.
solution: Built incident classification and runbook generation workflow integrating ticketing data, resolution summaries, and reusable remediation scripts.
outcome: Cut mean time to resolution by 30%, improved first-response consistency, and created an expanding operational knowledge base.
